title: Round estimated arrival time to five minutes
goal: uses Math.round and unit conversion to round a value to the specified step size.
summary: Shuttle bus signboard is updated every 5 minutes. The estimated time given by the interface can be minutes converted from fractional seconds.
tasks: Completes roundPickup(minutes), rounding non-negative minutes to the nearest multiple of 5.
When the distance between the upper and lower two items is the same, take the larger multiple and keep 0.

example.note: First convert the quantity into the number of groups with the specified step size, round it off and then multiply it back to the step size.

hint: Math.round will only round a number to an integer. First divide by 5, then multiply by 5.
